brainstorming.label: Brainstorming
brainstorming.description: Generating new ideas and possibilities together.
brainstorming.skillsNeeded: Needs people comfortable generating and building on ideas quickly: Intuition for spotting new possibilities, Perceiving for staying open before locking in too early, and enough Extraversion in the room to keep energy and momentum going.

operational.label: Operational execution
operational.description: Turning a plan into consistent, reliable delivery.
operational.skillsNeeded: Needs people who turn plans into steady execution: Sensing for practical, on-the-ground detail, and Judging for structure and follow-through. Thinking and Feeling both work here, depending on whether the work is more process-heavy or more people-heavy.

client-facing.label: Client-facing
client-facing.description: Working directly with clients or stakeholders.
client-facing.skillsNeeded: Needs people comfortable reading and responding to others: Feeling for empathy and rapport, and enough Extraversion to carry a conversation and build trust. Sensing or Intuition both work, depending on whether the client wants concrete answers or big-picture vision.

crisis.label: Crisis response
crisis.description: Reacting fast and adapting under real pressure.
crisis.skillsNeeded: Needs people who can decide quickly under pressure: Thinking for fast, logical calls, Sensing for reading the real situation in front of them rather than theorizing, and Perceiving for adapting as things keep changing.
